(* --- Mesajul ca număr (ASCII -> hex -> zecimal) --- *)
m = FromDigits[ToCharacterCode["Dulgheru Ion"], 256]
IntegerString[m, 16]

(* --- Sarcina 2.1: RSA, n >= 2048 biți --- *)
p = RandomPrime[{3*2^1022, 2^1024 - 1}];
q = RandomPrime[{3*2^1022, 2^1024 - 1}];
{BitLength[p], BitLength[q], PrimeQ[p], PrimeQ[q], p != q}
n = p*q;
BitLength[n]
phi = (p - 1)*(q - 1);
e = 65537;
GCD[e, phi]
d = PowerMod[e, -1, phi];
Mod[e*d, phi]
c = PowerMod[m, e, n]
m2 = PowerMod[c, d, n]
m2 == m
FromCharacterCode[IntegerDigits[m2, 256]]

(* --- Parametrii din enunț pentru 2.2 și 3 --- *)
pp = ;
g = 2;
{BitLength[pp], PrimeQ[pp], PrimeQ[(pp - 1)/2]}

(* --- Sarcina 2.2: ElGamal --- *)
x = RandomInteger[{2, pp - 2}];
y = PowerMod[g, x, pp];
k = RandomInteger[{2, pp - 2}];
c1 = PowerMod[g, k, pp];
c2 = Mod[m*PowerMod[y, k, pp], pp];
s = PowerMod[c1, x, pp];
sInv = PowerMod[s, -1, pp];
mE = Mod[c2*sInv, pp]
mE == m
FromCharacterCode[IntegerDigits[mE, 256]]

(* --- Sarcina 3: Diffie-Hellman + cheie AES-256 --- *)
a = RandomInteger[{2, pp - 2}];
b = RandomInteger[{2, pp - 2}];
bigA = PowerMod[g, a, pp];
bigB = PowerMod[g, b, pp];
kAlisa = PowerMod[bigB, a, pp];
kBob = PowerMod[bigA, b, pp];
kAlisa == kBob
kAES = IntegerString[Hash[ByteArray[IntegerDigits[kAlisa, 256, 256]], "SHA256"], 16, 64]
kAES2 = IntegerString[Mod[kAlisa, 2^256], 16, 64]
